name: Kurumi Nonaka
source:
I have known Kurumi and her sister [url=https://vndb.org/c153156]Yuki[/url] since early childhood. We met again recently, and I clearly saw that Kurumi, like Yuki, has feelings for [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url]. Despite everything that happened in the village, she has just turned eighteen. Even Yuki is encouraging her to join my harem.

[In game description]
